title: Semi-Supervised Learning Framework for Credit Risk Prediction
summary: A Jupyter Notebook-based framework exploring semi-supervised learning techniques to improve credit risk prediction on a tabular financial dataset. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) is run directly in the notebook to fit on the credit data and generate synthetic rows for augmentation, alongside metadata detection and evaluate_quality checks.
